terms.definition: A living thing that breaks down dead plants and animals.
terms.function: Recycles materials back to the soil.

terms.definition: The return of materials from dead matter to the soil for reuse.
terms.function: Keeps the soil rich for producers.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps life's materials in circulation.

terms.definition: A decomposer that breaks down dead wood and leaves.
terms.whereItIs: Mushrooms and molds on forest floors.
terms.whyItMatters: They digest what no other organism can.
